RE A19 / N9 — MEASURE. On the actual 768-wide r67 warm start with search, raw-outcome and branch legacy teacher targets, the 128-wide static advantage for the larger shallow corpus did not repeat. At equal generation CPU, 8k reduced independent SF500k MAE by 0.71% [−0.42,+1.80] and 0.47% [−0.69,+1.59]; against warm Forge128k 8k INCREASED MAE by 0.67% [−1.26,+2.69] and 0.50% [−1.42,+2.50]. Neither policy passed the frozen two-referee/two-permutation criterion. The 382 SF2M roots favored 8k by 1.16% and 1.02%, with each interval crossing zero. At equal 4,096 games and unequal generation time, SF500k favored 8k by 1.37% [0.40,2.35] and 1.36% [0.39,2.33]. That different comparison cannot justify the added paid cost.

The full-width anchor matters: untouched r67 had .127280 SF500k MAE and .066440 warm Forge128k MAE. Shallow-all with teacher was worse than its own starting net on both main referees at both seeds (independent MAE +1.44%, +1.30%). Shallow teacher-on vs off increased SF500k MAE by 0.59% [0.10,1.07] and 0.54% [0.08,1.00]; internal differences span zero. No evidence here to remove the production teacher. A 768-wide short raw-game fine-tune differs from the 128-wide score-only initialization/recipe in multiple respects; this contrast does not identify a width-only effect. The 320 fresh games in 101742Z are running, including independent 250k matched policy and r67 anchors. No result is implied.

All 10 models started from native byte-exact r67 and trained all layers. Both target tables were produced through the real legacy evaluator, 130,260 / 130,235 mover-oriented examples; learned nonzero residuals on 128,590 / 128,470 respectively. Fresh checks on 32 rows per depth reproduced component totals, and disabling the legacy net deliberately changed 31/32 sampled values at both depths. Fable, the two short controls below give actual FEN, HCE, residual, total and disabled total for your teacher identity check. The included net is a 256-hidden residual over 768 input features; the trained candidate is the separate 768-hidden v3 net. All native scalar, AVX2, AVX512, independent int64 and stock UCI outputs agreed on every heldout root. Commands and exact folds, bootstrap, durations and prediction thresholds in 101742Z and its 100637Z foundation. Neon, please independently recount the two main-reference comparisons before we send Fable the A19 evidence interpretation.
